strategy.primary: Amass and the Ring: every opponent spell amasses Orcs 1, the Army's combat damage makes the Ring tempt you, and each temptation offers Sauron's discard-hand/draw-four and pumps every Nazgûl (7 copies).
strategy.secondary: Army support (Great Goblin, Foul-Hearted; Mauhúr; The Great Goblin; Widespread Brutality), evasion (Minas Morgul, Rogue's Passage, The Black Gate, Orcish Siegemaster) and Roaming Throne to double Sauron or Nazgûl triggers.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Sauron, the Dark Lord
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Ward—Sacrifice a legendary artifact or legendary creature.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, amass Orcs 1.
Whenever an Army you control deals combat damage to a player, the Ring tempts you.
Whenever the Ring tempts you, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw four cards.

identity.why: Amass on opponent spells; Ring temptations draw four.
Seven Wraiths that grow on each temptation.
Amass, repeat amass and Army trample.
Shadow for the Army and Wraith synergy.
